title: A wearable IMU-based method for measuring biomechanical parameters in hammer throwing
why: Five Spanish national-level hammer throwers, 6 trials each with homologated implements at the CAR in Madrid: three off-the-shelf IMUs (right instep, lumbar, wrist) matched VICON at ICC 0.977 on single/double support phase durations and ICC 0.976 on angular displacements.
